title: Show a human version beneath the product mark
description: Change only the shell presentation of the runtime version beneath the Gateship logo. When the snapshot version contains SemVer build metadata such as `0.302.0+8146b060...`, render only `v0.302.0` in the sidebar. Preserve an ordinary version without build metadata unchanged apart from the existing `v` prefix, and keep the empty-version behavior hidden. Strip only the `+...` build-metadata suffix; do not reinterpret, validate or rewrite prerelease text or arbitrary non-empty runtime values. Keep the exact full version string flowing through the existing snapshot/client/AppProps contract so diagnostic identity remains available to the runtime and existing APIs; this slice must not alter version generation, stale-service comparison, self-update identity, release metadata or any server response. Implement the display rule as a small pure presentation helper owned by the UI and extend the existing shell static-render tests in place to prove a full `0.302.0+<commit>` value renders exactly `v0.302.0`, does not expose the commit beneath the logo, while plain and empty versions retain their current behavior. Do not add a tooltip, disclosure, settings row, endpoint, dependency, regex gate or snapshot test. Update HANDOFF.md only to record the stable post-merge presentation rule: the shell shows human SemVer while exact build identity remains in the APIs. Preserve its resilient header, history and approval boundary. Out of scope: locale selection, localization of another surface, /settings diagnostics, version parsing outside presentation, release or update behavior, database or lifecycle changes.
